# Huia

> Multi-tenant OpenID Connect / OAuth 2.0 (Huia.OpenId) and single-tenant bearer-token (Huia.Headless) identity for ASP.NET Core, with first-party Next.js and Nuxt 4 client libraries.

Huia provides end-to-end identity infrastructure spanning backend (.NET 10 / OpenIddict / EF Core) and frontend (Next.js 14/15 and Nuxt 4), with strict tenant isolation, automated key rotation, and secure encrypted session management.
